info.title: CriptoNous x402
info.description: CriptoNous x402 — pay-per-query crypto market signals with cited sources. DEX pair flow (accumulation or distribution; not a named whale, company, or ETF unless a public label exists), narrative heat with the source named, regime context, and a committee reading with dissent. If the ticker is not this contract, the reading says so. Free shape: GET /x402/sample. First buy: hermes.pulse $0.01 · pair flow poseidon.flow $0.05 · sealed reading delfos.signal $0.10 · day loop session.24h $9 (12 reads ≤ $1). Settle: Solana USDC · Base USDC · BNB · Robinhood USDG. ETH L1 deferred_gas — pay via Base (eip155:8453). AccessPass + HMAC receipts (notFiscal). NFA — analysis only; never a trade order, execution, or custody. Manifest /.well-known/x402 · skill.md · llms.txt.
info.x-guidance: CriptoNous x402 market reading with cited sources: pair accumulation vs distribution (not a named whale unless a public label) · narrative heat · regime · confluence with dissent. First buy: GET /x402/resource/hermes.pulse ($0.01) → HTTP 402 without an API key → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (PayAI / Dexter / OpenFacilitator) or PayBox. Pair flow next: poseidon.flow $0.05 · sealed reading delfos.signal $0.10 · smoke kit sum $0.16 (no discount). Day loop: session.24h $9 → 12 reads ≤ $1. Keyed MCP: tool request_payment {"sku"} (see /x402/mcp/tools) then pay + request_verify + X-PAYMENT; consume pass — never pay twice. Rails: Solana USDC · Base · BNB · Robinhood USDG. Discovery: /.well-known/x402 · /skill.md (Buy now) · /llms.txt · /x402/hello. NFA — analysis only; no trade execution.

intelligence.description: Market reading for this SKU. Prefer intelligence.ownerBrief for the human owner.

panel.description: Evidence panel roles (sentiment, flow, regime, etc.).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC reading timestamp.

ownerBrief.description: Plain EN/ES takeaway for the human owner — accumulation/distribution language, no mythology.

degraded.description: true when part of the evidence panel was unavailable.

402.description: Payment Required — SPL USDC + memo via request_payment flow.

409.description: Payment signature already used (replay). No new charge was made.

503.description: Settled on-chain but intelligence sources are unavailable. Retry with the same PAYMENT-SIGNATURE — no new payment required.
